description: Native qualitative enemy profiles for four Synthesis force families and their thirty-six named battlefield roles from pages 82-104.

entries.title: Unit 0 Forces
entries.summary: A varied synthesis army combining skeletal energy infantry, cloaked scouts, massive armored platforms, battlefield command networks, fortresses, infiltrators, and unstable bio-mechanical abominations.
body: Unit 0 forces are visually role-coded, from sleek skeletal Echoes to grotesque Devourers. Their tactical range spans direct assault, long-range armor, command and coordination, stealth, sabotage, area denial, and stationary defense.

Source vulnerabilities include overheating, lightweight construction, slow movement, exposed joints, explosive feedback, network dependence, fixed positions, unstable bio-mechanical fusion, maintenance burden, and cloaking drain.

sourceRefs.notes: Nine Unit 0 battlefield roles with appearance, strengths, and weaknesses.

entries.title: Techno-Phantom Collective
entries.summary: The Void Seer’s force combines advanced technology with arcane and illusionary influence, emphasizing stealth, sensor deception, energy systems, reality distortion, and spectral battlefield identities.
body: The Techno-Phantom Collective fields Spectral Wraiths, Ethereal Stalkers, Phantom Juggernauts, Void Titans, Void Shapers, the Void Seer, Ethereal Bastions, Nihilants, and Specter Weavers.

Their roles range from reconnaissance and infiltration to heavy assault, command, fortress defense, and reality-distorting abomination deployment. Common limitations include fragility, energy drain, slow heavy units, network or command dependence, stationary defenses, and unstable hybrid systems.

sourceRefs.notes: Nine Techno-Phantom battlefield roles and faction summary.

entries.title: Bio-Machine Juggernauts
entries.summary: The Biomech Tyrant’s faction fuses advanced robotics with organic systems to create adaptable infantry, stealth organisms, siege bodies, commanders, fortresses, and unstable regenerative horrors.
body: Bio-Machine Juggernauts visibly combine dark machinery, armor, living tissue, biotic systems, and organic weaponry. Their battlefield roles include Bio-Sentries, Flesh-Wraiths, Titanium Behemoths, Colossal Juggernauts, Biotic Demolishers, the Biomech Tyrant, Goliath Fortresses, Devourers, and Shadow Stalkers.

Their strengths center on integrated biological resilience, heavy firepower, stealth, regeneration, command authority, and specialized ordnance. Weaknesses include exposed organic systems, maintenance demand, size, limited maneuverability, heavy energy consumption, stationary defense, and unstable hybrid construction.

sourceRefs.notes: Nine Bio-Machine Juggernaut roles and faction summary.

entries.title: The Anarchic Swarm
entries.summary: The Hive Sovereign commands an insectoid bio-mechanical army built around numerical superiority, hive coordination, rapid adaptation, modular bodies, and relentless assault.
body: The Anarchic Swarm fields Swarm Drones, Recon Beetles, Colossus Drones, Warlord Behemoths, Infestation Grenadiers, the Hive Sovereign, Hive Fortresses, Swarm Lords, and Shadow Stingers.

The faction’s strengths are mobility, swarm tactics, adaptive armor, heavy firepower, coordinated command, automated defenses, regeneration, psychic influence, and biotic camouflage. Its recurring weaknesses include isolation, low durability, reduced mobility in heavy forms, energy dependence, finite munitions, stationary fortresses, unstable hybrid design, and cloaking drain.

sourceRefs.notes: Nine Anarchic Swarm roles and faction summary.

entries.title: Synthesis Enemy Role Roster
entries.summary: Thirty-six named enemy types map four Synthesis force families across nine recurring battlefield roles.
body: The roster is qualitative. It is intended for identification, encounter composition, tactical expectations, and later cross-linking to native stat records.
The name ‘The Devourers’ is used for both Unit 0 and Bio-Machine Juggernaut abomination classes. They remain separate faction records rather than being merged.
